subtitle.zh-CN: 棕色小熊 · 圆圆小脚
subtitle.zh-TW: 棕色小熊 · 圓圓小腳

description.zh-CN: 暖棕色的小熊，脸颊黄黄的，圆滚滚的小脚走起路来一颠一颠，一二最好的伙伴。
description.zh-TW: 暖棕色的小熊，臉頰黃黃的，圓滾滾的小腳走起路來一顛一顛，一二最好的夥伴。
description.en: A warm brown bear with yellow cheeks whose round little feet bounce as it walks. Yier’s best friend.

look: small warm-brown bear, round head, round ears with lighter inner ear, yellow cheek blush, ":3" mouth, short round feet
